Let

I = ∫ 3*exp(x)*sin(x) dx = 3*∫ exp(x)*sin(x) dx.

Using integration by parts for ∫ exp(x)*sin(x) dx:

∫ exp(x)*sin(x) dx = (1/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x)) + C.

Therefore,

∫ 3*exp(x)*sin(x) dx = (3/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x)) + C.

<answer>(3/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x)) + C</answer>
